annotations.title: Losing a job in the Netherlands: severance, WW, visa and 30% ruling

description: For an employee whose Dutch contract ends: the statutory transition payment (transitievergoeding), unemployment benefit (WW) amount and duration under UWV rules, and for expats the highly skilled migrant / Blue Card search period end date and the last start date for a new job to keep the 30% ruling.

employment_end.description: Last day of the contract, YYYY-MM-DD

employment_start.description: Start date at this employer, YYYY-MM-DD

four_of_five_years.description: Worked in at least 4 of the last 5 calendar years. Default true.

gross_monthly.description: Gross base salary per month in euros, without holiday allowance

permit.description: none (EU citizen), hsm (highly skilled migrant) or bluecard. Default none.

permit_two_years.description: Has held the permit for 2 years or more when the job ends. Default false.

work_history_start_year.description: First calendar year with 208+ paid hours in NL or the EU. Default: the employment start year.
